Category index archetype; represents taxonomy/navigation. Audited once because item grids share the home card template.

Search-results archetype reached through the global search form; covers query navigation and result cards.
Primary account form flow; covers labels, autofill, validation, authentication and age-assurance interruption.
Representative HTTP failure/recovery state using a deliberately missing route.

findings.summary: System color preference is ignored
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme rule; the page defaults localStorage to dark-theme rather than following the OS. The dark emulation produced the same fixed-dark age-gate rendering.
findings.suggestedFix: Use color-scheme and prefers-color-scheme (or light-dark()) as the default, while preserving an explicit user override.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference does not stop continuous animation
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched, the probe still found 13 running animations, including twelve infinite 1-second ping animations; the CSS contains no reduced-motion query.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential ping, ad, and transition animation inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: No high-contrast or forced-colors adaptation
findings.evidence: The contrast probe confirmed prefers-contrast: more while finding no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules; Lighthouse separately found 17 color-contrast failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast styles that preserve visible text, controls, borders, and focus indicators.

findings.summary: Route changes have no continuity cue
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across the MPA templates found no view-transition-name or @view-transition usage, so moving from listing to detail is an abrupt document swap.
findings.suggestedFix: Add opt-in cross-document View Transitions for stable shared elements, with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long listings provide no scroll-state-aware orientation
findings.evidence: The home page is over 15,000 CSS pixels tall, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state container queries or progress/orientation treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact sticky header or lightweight scroll progress/state treatment on long listing pages.

findings.summary: Custom overlays are manually fixed rather than viewport-aware
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM includes manually fixed ad and playlist overlays, while the CSS probe found no anchor positioning or fallback positions.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native popover/dialog primitives and CSS anchor positioning with position-try fallbacks for attached menus and tooltips.

findings.summary: Navigation does not visibly direct attention after a move
findings.evidence: The listing/detail inspection found no directional transition, highlight, scroll marker, or other attention cue after route or in-page navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add restrained directional/shared-element cues and ensure focus moves to the destination heading.

findings.summary: Fixed ad and pop-under code competes with core content
findings.evidence: The rendered DOM contains a fixed 410px video ad with z-index 9999 and webExperienceManager pop-under code bound to video links. This is additional to the jurisdictional age gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove pop-unders and auto-injected fixed video ads; defer clearly labelled advertising and make it easy to dismiss.

findings.summary: The mandatory age gate is an inaccessible custom modal
findings.evidence: Screenshots show a full-screen age-verification gate, but DOM inspection found a fixed div with no dialog role, aria-modal, labelled relationship, or native dialog/popover semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the gate as a labelled modal dialog, trap and restore focus, make background content inert, and provide a clear exit/alternative path.

findings.summary: Ad chrome and hundreds of controls overwhelm the listing
findings.evidence: The home probe counted 396 interactive elements and an iframe; rendered DOM also injects slider/native ad chrome around the content grid.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce above-the-fold controls, remove low-value ad chrome, and progressively reveal secondary actions.

findings.summary: Mobile listing and detail templates overflow horizontally
findings.evidence: At a 360px visual viewport, layout metrics reported a 369px document width and 9px horizontal overflow on both home and detail.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the fixed/min-width source, use intrinsic sizing and max-inline-size:100%, and test at 320-360px.

findings.summary: Reusable cards adapt only through viewport breakpoints
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container/container-type usage despite cards and ad widgets being reused in grids and side surfaces at different widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/grid shells containment and use size container queries where component layout changes.

findings.summary: Some interactive targets are too small
findings.evidence: The home probe found 18 visible interactive elements below 24px in at least one dimension; Lighthouse also reports accessibility failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase touch targets toward 44x44 CSS pixels, retain visible focus, and provide non-hover labels/actions.

findings.summary: Core content has a biometric-only access path in this region
findings.evidence: All visual captures were replaced by a mandatory “AI face check” gate linking to an external partner. No non-biometric verification option, exit, or alternative access route is offered.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer proportionate, privacy-preserving age-assurance alternatives and explain data handling before sending users to the partner.

findings.summary: The age gate offers no recovery or alternative state
findings.evidence: The first viewport exposes only “Start age verification”; it has no cancel, help, retry explanation, unsupported-camera path, or alternative verification control.
findings.suggestedFix: Add clear help, retry, cancel/leave, camera-denied, and alternative-verification states without losing the user’s destination.

findings.summary: Resource delivery is heavier and less cacheable than needed
findings.evidence: Lighthouse transferred 2,943 KiB and estimated 1,270 KiB cache savings; HAR recorded 71 requests, while image delivery and render-blocking audits also failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Set durable immutable caching for versioned assets, shorten critical chains, and prioritize only the LCP resource.

findings.summary: Unused JavaScript and CSS ship on the entry path
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 170 KiB unused JavaScript and 11 KiB unused CSS on home, while third-party scripts dominate request cost.
findings.suggestedFix: Split route code, conditionally load ad/player dependencies, and remove unused legacy bundles.

findings.summary: Accessible names, roles, and alternatives are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an aria-allowed-attr failure; the image audit found 20 images without alt text, and the custom gate has no modal role or accessible modal state.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix invalid ARIA, give meaningful images/controls names, mark decorative images empty-alt, and expose the gate as a real labelled dialog.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail minimum contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 17 failing contrast nodes on home and 4 on login.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/surface tokens to WCAG AA and verify normal, hover, focus, dark, and high-contrast states.

findings.summary: Heading and focus order are not logical
findings.evidence: The home outline starts with four H2 sections before its H1; Lighthouse found four positive tabindex values on login, forcing an authored order that can diverge from reading order.
findings.suggestedFix: Place the page H1 before section headings, keep DOM and visual order aligned, and remove positive tabindex values.

findings.summary: Video has no caption track and small targets remain
findings.evidence: The detail probe found two videos with zero track elements, and the home probe found 18 sub-24px interactive targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide captions/transcripts for meaningful media, enlarge targets, and retest reflow/zoom.

findings.summary: Image dimensions and aspect ratios are unsound
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an incorrectly stretched RTA image and unsized images; the image audit found 12 missing dimensions and 15 oversized resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height with the correct aspect ratio and use responsive sources sized to the rendered slot.

findings.summary: Browser hygiene issues remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse logged a Cookie issue in DevTools; login also had three BFCache failure reasons. Source maps, paste prevention, prompts, and deprecated APIs otherwise passed.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the cookie inspector issue and BFCache blockers, then verify a back/forward navigation restores cleanly.

findings.summary: Sixteen links are not crawlable
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable anchors, and the probe counted 16 javascript: links, including live cards and “Show More”.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations for navigation and buttons for actions; retain descriptive link text.

findings.summary: Transport defenses and cookie flags are missing
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but headers inspection found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. All 10 observed cookies lacked Secure and several use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; mark cookies Secure and use the strictest workable SameSite/HttpOnly settings.

findings.summary: Tracking and ad third parties load before meaningful consent
findings.evidence: The tracker capture found 9 third-party origins, including Google Tag Manager/Analytics and multiple ad networks; analytics cookies last about 400 days and are set without Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors and retention, defer non-essential analytics/ads until valid consent, and document each data recipient.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only
findings.evidence: The login form exposes username/current-password fields and no WebAuthn/passkey flow. Permission prompts did not fire on load, but the relevant authentication path is not phishing-resistant.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration and authentication with password fallback and recovery.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent
findings.evidence: The response has neither clickjacking protection nor CSP frame-ancestors, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or origin-isolation policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a restrictive policy baseline and tighten it per route, including frame-ancestors and permissions allowlists.

findings.summary: Ad and playlist overlays rely on fragile manual positioning/state
findings.evidence: DOM inspection shows custom fixed overlays with very high z-indexes and manual jQuery hide/state handling; the ad slider is positioned off-screen then animated in.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace manual overlay state with dialog/popover/top-layer primitives and resilient viewport-aware positioning.

findings.summary: Localized routes exist, but layout CSS is not writing-mode ready
findings.evidence: Pages expose lang and 12 hreflang variants, but CSS inspection found no logical properties and extensive physical left/right positioning.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dir-aware markup and logical inline/block properties; test a translated RTL fixture.

findings.summary: Video links are wired to pop-under advertising
findings.evidence: Rendered source calls webExperienceManager.bindTo([“.vidLinkFX”]) with under:true, so selecting core video links can also open an advertising tab/window.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove pop-under binding from core actions and keep advertising explicit, labelled, and independently activated.

findings.summary: Login bypasses native required-field validation
findings.evidence: The login control is type=button and calls document.forms[0].submit(); although required fields make checkValidity false, form.submit() bypasses constraint validation and submit events.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a submit button and requestSubmit(); show field-level errors after interaction and announce the summary accessibly.

findings.summary: Account access and age assurance lack safer alternatives
findings.evidence: The account path is password-only, while regional entry requires a third-party AI face check without a non-biometric alternative in the gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkeys and recovery for accounts, and offer transparent, reversible age-assurance choices before third-party transfer.

findings.summary: Images are not consistently optimized for their slots
findings.evidence: The image audit found 46 images without srcset, 18 legacy-format images, 15 oversized images, and 17 below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive sources, set sizes, lazy-load below-fold media, and avoid oversized decorative assets.

findings.summary: Background analytics and advertising work is disproportionate
findings.evidence: HAR/trackers evidence shows analytics, Cloudflare insight, live-cam, ad-network, and autoplay-ad media requests before the user reaches content.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer or eliminate non-essential background fetches and batch analytics after consent.

findings.summary: Third-party ad/media budget is disproportionate
findings.evidence: Nine third-party origins and fixed injected video advertising add network, CPU, and privacy cost to a media-heavy page that already has a 2.9 MiB load.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict third-party budget, remove pop-under/video ad formats, and lazy-load any retained media after intent.

Deploy a modern security-header and cookie baseline
Fix contrast, focus order, target size, names, and captions
Optimize images, caching, critical delivery, and route bundles
Honor system color, motion, and contrast preferences
Repair mobile overflow and introduce component-level responsiveness
Use native validation and add passkeys/recovery
Replace custom overlays with dialog/popover and resilient positioning
Make all navigation destinations crawlable and orientation-aware
